data.name: Ashirwad
data.gender_notes: Ashirwad is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashirwad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ashirwadh', meaning 'blessing' or 'favor'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the gods bestow blessings upon those named Ashirwad. This name is often given to a child as a sign of hope for a prosperous and blessed life. The name Ashirwad carries the meaning “Blessing, Favor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashirwad usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May this name bring you blessings and favor from the divine.
data.etymology: Ashirwad belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing, Favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashirwad total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_sanskrit.name: अशीर्वाद
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows auspicious blessings, adorns the head with sacred thread, performs the yajña (sacred fire ritual) and performs the vāgdarśana (divine vision).

in_hindi.name: अशिर्वाद

in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who receives the sacred thread from the pujārī (priest) during a yajña (sacred fire ritual) and receives the divine vision.

in_telugu.name: అశీర్వాద్
